fusions.name: Unhurried Grip
fusions.desc: A strand closes on the first enemy it meets, dealing 16 damage and stunning it for 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Account
fusions.desc: Draws a target up to 6 tiles away into a slow loop, dealing 18 damage that rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Slow Hang
fusions.desc: Lets your strands take the weight off you, cutting the damage you take by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Inevitable Growth
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.6 health a second, permanently.
